node.title: Re: sending http request
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [rogerdsw6],

If it's just a simple GET request, you could use [mod://HTTP::Tiny] to send the request, which has been a core module for a few years now.

To build the request URL, I'd recommend the module [mod://URI], for which I once wrote some simple example code [id://1159419|here].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
